kartaView.method: Public documentation/terms in site JavaScript; west, central, east radius queries and a geographic rectangle verified against all 54 complete route polylines
kartaView.limitations: The route rectangle returns zero camera records; the east radius query returns seven off-route cameras. Two nearest thumbnails are inspected separately. Camera-coordinate lookup does not establish visible-feature coverage or total source absence.
